dossier.headline: Misteri 9 Korban di Apartemen Dingin Pinggiran Kota
dossier.chronologySummary: Penyelidikan orang hilang membawa polisi ke apartemen lantai dua. Di dalamnya ditemukan sembilan kotak pendingin berisi bukti mengerikan.
dossier.hookIdea: Sembilan nyawa lenyap hanya dalam rentang waktu dua bulan.
dossier.fullBodyText: Polisi metropolitan awalnya menyelidiki hilangnya seorang wanita muda berusia 23 tahun...

script.title: 9 JENAZAH DALAM KOTAK ES
script.fullText: Sembilan nyawa lenyap tanpa jejak. Dua bulan. Sembilan korban. Semua dalam satu apartemen dingin. Takahiro Shiraishi, pria soliter, dikenal pendiam dan tak mencolok. Laporan orang hilang membawa polisi ke apartemen lantai dua. Kotak pendingin putih. Di dalamnya, potongan tubuh manusia. Polisi menyita smartphone retak dan catatan transaksi mencurigakan. Peta digital menunjukkan korban berasal dari berbagai wilayah Jepang. Di balik pintu, kamar mandi menjadi tempat pembantaian senyap. Penggerebekan dilakukan. Shiraishi ditangkap tanpa perlawanan. Sembilan kotak pendingin. Sembilan kepala. Bukti yang mengerikan. Transaksi rahasia mengungkap motif: uang dan kekuasaan. Berkas otopsi mencengangkan. Shiraishi mengaku membunuh semuanya. Sidang berlangsung. Palu hakim mengetuk, ruang sidang hening. Vonis mati dijatuhkan. Keadilan ditegakkan, meski nyawa tak kembali. Arsip terkunci. Kasus ditutup. Tapi kegelapan itu nyata.

beats.visualCue: Cover headline dramatis: 9 JENAZAH DALAM KOTAK ES

beats.narration: Dua bulan. Sembilan korban. Semua dalam satu apartemen dingin.
beats.visualCue: Apartemen terpencil diselimuti kabut, jendela gelap, suasana mencekam.

beats.narration: Takahiro Shiraishi, pria soliter, dikenal pendiam dan tak mencolok.
beats.visualCue: Close-up wajah Shiraishi tanpa ekspresi, latar belang hitam-putih.

beats.narration: Laporan orang hilang membawa polisi ke apartemen lantai dua.
beats.visualCue: Pintu apartemen terbuka perlahan, sorot lampu senter menembus gelap.

beats.narration: Kotak pendingin putih. Di dalamnya, potongan tubuh manusia.
beats.visualCue: Meja forensik 45 derajat, kotak es putih terbuka, label bukti merah.

beats.narration: Polisi menyita smartphone retak dan catatan transaksi mencurigakan.
beats.visualCue: Layar ponsel retak menyala, berkas catatan berserakan di meja penyidik.

beats.narration: Peta digital menunjukkan korban berasal dari berbagai wilayah Jepang.
beats.visualCue: Peta Jepang dengan garis merah menghubungkan kota-kota ke satu titik.

beats.narration: Di balik pintu, kamar mandi menjadi tempat pembantaian senyap.
beats.visualCue: Interior kamar mandi kotor, noda gelap, lampu redup berkedip.

beats.narration: Penggerebekan dilakukan. Shiraishi ditangkap tanpa perlawanan.
beats.visualCue: Polisi bersenjata mendobrak pintu, Shiraishi diborgol dengan tenang.

beats.narration: Sembilan kotak pendingin. Sembilan kepala. Bukti yang mengerikan.
beats.visualCue: Barisan kotak es putih berjajar, satu terbuka memperlihatkan isinya.

beats.narration: Transaksi rahasia mengungkap motif: uang dan kekuasaan.
beats.visualCue: Catatan keuangan dengan angka besar, bayangan tangan menghitung uang.

beats.narration: Berkas otopsi mencengangkan. Shiraishi mengaku membunuh semuanya.
beats.visualCue: Dokumen otopsi tebal, close-up mata Shiraishi tanpa penyesalan.

beats.narration: Sidang berlangsung. Palu hakim mengetuk, ruang sidang hening.
beats.visualCue: Ruang pengadilan gelap, hakim mengangkat palu, wajah Shiraishi datar.

beats.narration: Vonis mati dijatuhkan. Keadilan ditegakkan, meski nyawa tak kembali.
beats.visualCue: Timbangan keadilan miring, bayangan tali gantungan di latar belakang.

beats.narration: Arsip terkunci. Kasus ditutup. Tapi kegelapan itu nyata.
beats.visualCue: Brankas baja tertutup, tulisan 'RAHASIA' memudar, latar hitam pekat.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 00: Mandatory High-CTR Cover Image
allKeyframes.prompt: A dramatic, high-CTR YouTube Shorts cover and thumbnail illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920), Graphic Novel Neo-Noir style. Visual Scene: A chilling crime scene hook depicting Interior apartemen lantai dua yang sempit dan pengap, diterangi satu lampu neon kuning yang berkedip. Di lantai, sembilan kotak pendingin putih berjejer rapi, salah satunya setengah terbuka memperlihatkan siluet gelap. Di dinding, bayangan chiaroscuro dari smartphone retak yang tergeletak di meja lipat, dengan catatan transaksi berserakan. Nuansa graphic novel neo-noir, kontras tinggi antara hitam pekat dan cahaya pucat, sudut pandang rendah yang mencekam.. Integrated Bold Typography: Prominent massive distressed headline text: '9 JENAZAH DALAM KOTAK ES' rendered in heavy stencil/impact typography in warm broken-white (#E6EDF3) with antique brass bronze accents (#C59B27) and deep drop shadows. Sub-headline ribbon banner: 'DUA BULAN, SEMBILAN NYAWA' in a deep dried crimson red tape (#8B2635) with sharp white lettering. Top warning header banner: '/// POLICE INVESTIGATION DOSSIER ///'. Artistic Style: Dynamic heavy inking, chiaroscuro lighting, gritty halftone screen tone dot pattern, cel-shaded shadows, matte graphic novel finish. Full bleed composition filling the entire 9:16 vertical canvas. No pastel colors, no oversaturation, no cartoonish elements.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 01: Hook Scene Silhouette
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Subject: An ominous silhouette standing in the shadow of a dim crime scene in Zama, Tokyo, heavy rain on pavement, yellow police tape marked 'KEEP OUT'. Full bleed vertical portrait framing, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with sharp volumetric spotlight piercing through cold mist, deep shadows, heavy contour inking, fine halftone dot screen tones, matte charcoal slate (#0D1117), cold storm gray, antique dull bronze (#C59B27). No text cards, no watermark.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 02: Police Criminal Mugshot
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). A stark police criminal mugshot sketch of suspect Takahiro Shiraishi, high contrast comic book inking, prisoner identification placard under chin, heavy cross-hatching, harsh interrogation spotlight, stamped with dried crimson red seal 'BERKAS PERKARA'. Full bleed, halftone shading, matte finish.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 03: The Hook Entrance / Digital Footprint
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). A cracked glowing smartphone screen shattered on cold reflective asphalt surface, subtle eerie cyan and dried crimson glow through dark shadows, rain-slicked night pavement, dynamic heavy inking, halftone screen tone texture. Full bleed 9:16.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 04: Forensic Evidence Desk 45°
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Subject: Isometric 45-degree angle top-down view of a police forensic evidence desk examining Kotak Pendingin Putih, clear plastic evidence bags, red evidence marker tags '01' and '02', tactical grid paper. Forensic items tightly arranged across a matte dark graphite workbench. Dynamic heavy inking, fine halftone dot shading, matte charcoal slate (#0D1117), antique bronze accents (#C59B27), dried crimson red stamps (#8B2635). Harsh desk lamp lighting. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 05: Cyber Crime Investigation Workstation
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Forensic cyber crime investigation workstation at police headquarters, glowing computer monitors displaying forensic audio waveforms and encrypted communication logs, dark chiaroscuro room, heavy linework, halftone shading. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 06: Tactical Transit Route Map
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Isometric top-down forensic transit map showing city route lines branching toward Zama, Tokyo, routes traced in red marker ink, dark parchment texture, magnifying glass, tactical surveillance grid. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 07: Isolated Crime Building Exterior
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Low angle exterior perspective of a quiet secluded suburban building in Zama, Tokyo at 2 AM, single eerie fluorescent light glowing from an upper window, yellow police barrier tape. Gritty graphic novel style, halftone sky, deep shadows. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 08: Dim Hallway Corridor Door
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Narrow dim hallway corridor inside a quiet building, weathered metal door with room number plate, long menacing shadow stretching out from beneath the door sill, heavy noir inking, dust motes in beam of light. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 09: Chilling Evidence Discovery Climax
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Forensic crime scene photograph: sealed evidence boxes and heavy tool containers with police barrier tape inside a dim room, yellow forensic evidence tags '03' and '04', intense chiaroscuro contrast, heavy graphic novel inking, deep dried crimson red accents (#8B2635). Full bleed vertical portrait.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 10: Seized Property & Banknotes
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Clear transparent police evidence bag containing thick stacks of banknotes and confiscated victim identity cards, barcode evidence sticker, resting on dark brushed steel forensic table. Heavy inking, halftone dots. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 11: Confidential Autopsy Dossier
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Manila autopsy file dossier and police investigation crime report folder spread out, red confidential rubber stamp 'RAHASIA / CONFIDENTIAL', censored monochrome incident documents, antique bronze accents. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 12: Judicial Courtroom Gavel
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Heavy dark hardwood judicial gavel bound with antique brass bronze bands resting on sound block, official court verdict decree documents, dramatic spotlight casting long shadows, solemn courtroom ambiance. Full bleed.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 13: Monolithic Scales of Justice
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Neoclassical black iron scales of justice hanging in exact balance under a dramatic volumetric ray of light inside a cathedral-like high court chamber, fine halftone screen tone, timeless justice allegory, deep shadows, matte charcoal slate (#0D1117). Full bleed vertical framing.

allKeyframes.label: Shot 14: Police Archive Vault Case Closed
allKeyframes.prompt: A cinematic graphic novel neo-noir illustration, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio (1080x1920). Massive heavy vault steel door of the police archives closing and locked, embossed brass seal, large bold red wax stamp across the seam reading 'BERKAS DITUTUP / CASE CLOSED', dark slate background with fine halftone dots. Full bleed.
